dogecoin.text: @eToroUS Doge coin has no real world utility and was never designed as a store of value. When you buy doge, you're just hoping someone else comes along to pay more than you did. There is no project to invest in. It's not an investment, it's purely speculative.

@DogecoinPulse Sell, count my blessings, and never purchase another useless Dogecoin again.
